This course is designed to introduce learners to the field of data science, covering the fundamental concepts and skills required to extract insights from complex data. Prerequisites include basic proficiency in statistics and computer programming, as well as a strong foundation in mathematics. Over a target duration of 12-16 hours, students will learn to craft engaging speeches, manage stage fright, and deliver persuasive presentations. Topics covered will include vocal techniques, body language, and audience analysis, as well as specific skills such as structuring a speech, using visual aids, and handling questions and feedback. By the end of the course, learners will be able to articulate their ideas with confidence and clarity, and will have the skills to adapt to various presentation settings.
